notes:
Checked 2026-10-09. Source of record: the five-page IEEE CSTE 2025 paper, DOI 10.1109/CSTE64638.2025.11091881, printed pp. 661-665. Read the entire markdown conversion, including the acknowledgments and references; the document contains no appendix and mentions no supplementary file, repository, preregistration, public data/code/materials availability, or availability on request. PDF text checks confirmed the data-related quotations and Table II. The acknowledgment reports funding only. forms/c088.json has empty data_url and code_url fields.

The quoted electronic-file sharing and scoring sheets concern the baseline AUT responses circulated internally to raters (Section II.C). They provide no public access route. The other quoted statement points to the paper's aggregate descriptive statistics. No relevant deposit was identified, so deposits is empty and there were no repository file listings, participant-level columns, or raw-data rows to inspect.

Publisher check: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11091881 returned HTTP 202 with no readable article content. https://doi.org/10.1109/cste64638.2025.11091881 likewise returned final HTTP 202 after redirecting to https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11091881/. Supplementary data on the publisher landing page could not be verified. No account, login, access request, or attempt to bypass a challenge was used.

Other printed links checked: reference [5], https://doi.org/10.1080/10400419.2018.1446491, redirected to https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/10400419.2018.1446491 and returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge; stopped there. Reference [14] prints a malformed Writer's Digest URL with a full-width colon and a space between 'open' and 'facing'. Normalizing the scheme punctuation and percent-encoding that printed space gave https://writersdigest.com/be-inspired/the-cold-open%20facing-the-blank-page, which redirected to the www host and returned HTTP 404. These are bibliographic citations to other works, with no indicated connection to this study's data. The PDF has no embedded hyperlink annotations. No data/repository link was supplied by the paper or form.

Search totals are the APIs' reported counts, including unrelated records. Broad Hui Liu searches were not exhaustively screened; focused title, author/topic, coauthor, and DOI queries found no relevant deposit. OSF's specified nodes endpoint filters node titles, so its author-name query does not establish that all projects contributed to by Hui Liu were searched. Search HTTP failures have null counts; the two initial Zenodo HTTP 400 responses were corrected by using the permitted anonymous page size of 25. Repeated identical successful requests are consolidated.

For form study S1, no public files were confirmed that link participants to randomized arms and drawing outcome scores or original drawings, texts, ideas, and prompts. Therefore no missing statistics or final.open_items can be resolved from confirmed public data. Table II already prints arm-level means, SDs, and sample sizes, but individual records were not found to verify these summaries, resolve the inconsistent labels/test statistics/degrees of freedom/p-values, or compute output diversity. Allocation/session records, scoring rubrics, demographic records, and intervention materials also remain unavailable in the sources checked.

Confidence is medium because the publisher supplement check was inconclusive, broad common-name searches were not exhaustive, and OSF title filtering has limited author coverage. none_found describes the result of these checks; it does not establish that no deposit exists.
